name: cable kneeling pull through
description: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.
instructions: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.
